description:
97 Salthill is an exceptional two-bedroom apartment, formerly configured as a three-bedroom, ideally positioned on the second floor within this prestigious gated development. Beautifully refurbished and presented in excellent condition throughout, the apartment benefits from an enviable triple aspect, with three separate balconies and spectacular sea views. The combination of its elevated position and extensive glazing ensures the property enjoys an abundance of natural light.

The well-proportioned accommodation extends to approximately 100 sq. m (1,076 sq. ft) with a further 39 sq.m. (420 sq.ft.) of external space. The apartment has been comprehensively refurbished to create a beautifully appointed interior. The superb kitchen/dining room incorporates an extensive range of fitted cabinetry together with a large central island, while direct access is provided to two adjoining balconies, including a particularly spacious south-facing terrace, ideal for outdoor dining and relaxation.

The separate living room is particularly impressive, generously proportioned and centred around an attractive open fireplace with bespoke fitted cabinetry and shelving. Glazed doors frame magnificent views across Dublin Bay and open directly onto a further balcony, from which the superb sea views can be fully enjoyed. The triple-aspect arrangement is a defining feature of the apartment, with balconies positioned to the front, rear and side providing a variety of outlooks over the sea, surrounding coastline and beautifully maintained landscaped grounds.

The bedroom accommodation is equally well considered. The main bedroom is a generous double room with an extensive range of fitted wardrobes and storage, together with direct access to one of the balconies and an en suite bathroom. A second double bedroom, also with fitted storage, and a separate bathroom complete the accommodation. Lift access within the building and surface parking further enhance the convenience of this apartment.

Constructed circa 1991 by the renowned Cosgrave developers in the grounds of the former Salthill Hotel, Salthill is one of Monkstown's most highly regarded residential developments. Apartments in Block D of the development are the most sought after and rarely come to the market. They are famous for providing generously proportioned accommodation with stunning views in a secure environment within walking distance of the excellent amenities within Monkstown Village and excellent transport.

Salthill/Monkstown DART station is immediately adjacent, while the villages of Monkstown and Dun Laoghaire are within easy walking distance, offering an excellent selection of cafés, restaurants, shops and everyday amenities. The seafront and Dun Laoghaire Harbour are also close at hand, with a marina, four yacht clubs, coastal walks and extensive recreational facilities.
